name: NusukChat 2.9.0: Mixed messages, Loading Text, tab bar actions
source: The DL Advisor's major update to 💬 Chat UI, 25 November 2026: _Chat Container Master (8 states), AI Chat Messages (37 variants), AI Tab Bar (8 statuses, light and dark master).

added.what: Nusuk: Body › Upper Footer (time + copy/up/down) › Content No BG with DL CTA Primary SM, Icon=No Icon, wrap 8 × 8, start edge. User: Body › Content No BG › Lower Footer (time).
Actions Only: Regular/Body/Two with 18 inline padding, 12 above one non-wrapping row of CTA Primary SM, no icon, gap 8; the row scrolls sideways.

changed.change: New below prop (Mixed). The footer is the Upper Footer between bubble and below for Nusuk, the Lower Footer last for user.

DL Loading Text (80700:13922) replaces the fading dots: 23 × 13, dots 3.66 on a 9 pitch, the active dot scales ×1.6, 150 ms a step, ease-out, from the start edge. AI Chat Messages Style=Loading: Nusuk 80835:33952, User 80392:4524.
User text is 80835:30455; 80392:4524 now holds User / Loading.
Master is now _AI Tab Bar Master with Darkmode=Off (80392:4168) and On (80821:21830); Status=Default shows the home indicator only.
Adds earth, global and mail-01 from Figma (not in the DL icon set). NationalitySearch uses global from here; it rendered blank before.

openDL: earth, global and mail-01 are used by the chat but missing from the DL icon set: request them for 🎨 Icons.
Loading Text is a remote library component: confirm it is published in the DL and named for code (LoadingDots?).

native.ios: Mixed: VStack(spacing 12) { bubble; HStack { time; Spacer; actions } (Nusuk); FlowLayout(spacing 8) of the DL primary .small buttons }. Loading: three 3.66 circles, scaleEffect 1.6 on the active one, 0.15 s steps, easeOut, honouring accessibilityReduceMotion. Tab bar actions: ScrollView(.horizontal, showsIndicators: false) of .small primary buttons, spacing 8, 18 leading/trailing content margins.
native.android: Mixed: Column(spacedBy(12.dp)) { bubble; Row { time; Spacer; actions } (Nusuk); FlowRow(spacedBy(8.dp), spacedBy(8.dp)) of PrimaryButton(size = Sm) }. Loading: three 3.66.dp circles, scale 1.6 on the active one, 150 ms steps, FastOutSlowIn/EaseOut, off when animations are disabled. Tab bar actions: LazyRow(horizontalArrangement = spacedBy(8.dp), contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 18.dp)).

breaking: NusukChat.Text user figma node changed to 80835:30455.
Loading no longer fades; it scales one dot at a time (respects reduced motion).
